name: Stage 16: Skottvångs gruva to Harsjöhult
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 16, Skottvångs gruva to Harsjöhult.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Skottvång is a strong but opening-hour-dependent start service node with parking, restaurant/cafe/pub, museum, toilets, shower, sauna, tap water, shelters, and bookable lodging nearby.

Harsjöhult has limited parking/access and the stage junction for stage 17, stage 16:1, and the Gallsjömossen loop. It is not a developed service node. Public transport is weak; the practical transit approach is usually via Åkers Styckebruk and stage 16:1.

Bredsjön is the strongest mid-stage rest/overnight node with shelter, fireplace, dry toilet, lake access, and reported tentable flat/rock areas nearby, but it should not be labeled as a formal or bookable campsite.

Neither endpoint is an easy normal-transit endpoint. Skottvång may require road walk, taxi, or prebooked complementary traffic; Harsjöhult normally means walking the 16:1 connector from Åkers Styckebruk.
waterSources: Skottvång has the only listed tap water, but access is service-dependent rather than guaranteed 24/7.

The three official springs at Lilla Vasskärr, southeast of Bredsjön, and Harsjöhult are natural/untested sources; filter/boil/treat and carry backup. Recent hikers found water at Bredsjön-side and Harsjöhult springs, but Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee flow or quality.
Bredsjön and Älskaren are natural lake water only, useful in an emergency with treatment but not potable refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10 km; Naturkartan/Äventyrligare list about 9.8-9.85 km, a 2026 Naturkartan GPX check measured about 9.82 km, and AllTrails-style traces show about 10.1 km with roughly 330 m ascent. OSM relation 3806516 is usable but has stale tags: distance=11 km and fixme=incomplete, while current member geometry measures about 9.87 km and supports the official 10 km.

Naturkartan GPX may be stored Harsjöhult-to-Skottvång even though the official direction is Skottvång to Harsjöhult. For OSM, graph-sort relation 3806516 and orient it from Skottvång node 2906044370 to the Harsjöhult/Stage 17 junction node 2926356244; keep the nearby Harsjöhult spring separate.

Skottvång is a small route hub rather than a single shared node. Stage 15 hands to Stage 16 at node 2906044370, while Stage 15:2 reaches the area through Stage 15/local connector logic and its southern reconnect node 2298697773 sits about 350 m away from the Stage 16 start.

Route character: mining history, forest paths, springs, wet low sections before Bredsjön, Bredsjön shelter, Älskaren, and Gallsjömossen reserve context near Harsjöhult. Reports describe it as moderate/easy, but after rain or in winter it can mean wet feet, icy descents, or slower boardwalk/bog travel.

Official pages for Stages 16, 16:1, and 17 showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A 2024-04-01 Stage 16 user comment thanked maintainers for warning about a flooded creek, and hiker reports mention wet ground, alternate-sign context before Bredsjön, and boardwalked wetland after Bredsjön; keep this as condition context rather than an active closure.
Heritage highlights include Skottvång mining area, Stora Vasskärr poorhouse/croft remains, an offergryta/giant pothole, Älgsjöbacken mine remains, old railway/slag heaps, and charcoal/cabin traces.

Gallsjömossen reserve rules apply near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs, collect plants/fungi/lichens beyond allowed personal-use exceptions, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. No specific public dog, fishing, or tenting ban was found on the reserve page, but local signs and fire bans still apply.

Do not route drivers along private/prohibited roads between Skottvång and Harsjöhult; use marked parking/access points and check local road signs. Hiker reports specifically describe a direct-looking Skottvång-Harsjöhult road approach being blocked/prohibited.

facilities.name: Skottvångs gruva stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start and service/heritage node with restaurant/cafe/pub, museum, parking, toilets, shower/sauna/tap context, and lodging nearby. Opening hours are limited, seasonal, and event-dependent, with food mostly a weekend/service-hours assumption.

facilities.name: Skottvång Stage 15/16 handoff
facilities.description: OSM node 2906044370 is the practical topological handoff from Stage 15 to Stage 16 and should be used when graph-sorting relation 3806516.

facilities.name: Skottvång parking
facilities.description: Start parking; Skottvång also lists a few overnight/RV/caravan spaces without electricity/toilet service and overflow at Roligheten about 500 m away. Check local signs.

facilities.name: Skottvång tap
facilities.description: Official tap water at Skottvång, but access may depend on bybastun/service opening or booked access and should not be treated as all-hours guaranteed.

facilities.name: Skottvång toilets
facilities.description: Toilet and accessible-toilet context in the Skottvång cultural village/service area; access may depend on opening hours, events, or booked facilities.

facilities.name: Skottvång lodging context
facilities.description: Bookable lodging context including Skumbo's 10 bunks plus bybastu/kitchen/water/showers/toilet, and nearby Häxans hus/Lilla Vasskärr/Krampan options. Book and verify access ahead.

facilities.name: Skottvång official stage-16 shelter
facilities.description: Official stage-16 shelter coordinate near Skottvång, distinct from the Stage 15/15:2 shelter coordinate. Sörmlandsleden shelters are shared, free, non-bookable, and have no guaranteed firewood or trash service.

facilities.name: Skottvång mapped shelter/fire roof
facilities.description: Separate mapped shelter/fire-roof near Skottvång listed by shelter/map sources and close to the Stage 15/15:2 shelter coordinate; keep distinct from the official stage-16 shelter and verify local use rules.

facilities.name: Lilla Vasskärr spring
facilities.description: Official spring about 1.5 km from Skottvång. Hiker reports describe good-looking water, but it remains natural/untested and should be treated.

facilities.name: Lilla Vasskärr picnic and B&B sign
facilities.description: Picnic/rest context near the first spring and sign toward nearby Lilla Vasskärr lodging, about 200 m off trail. Private/bookable lodging context only, not a public trail facility; sources list small cabins/cottages and simple facilities.

facilities.name: Fäboda fårbod
facilities.description: Private farm shop/craft/sheepskin context near the early route. Treat as opening-hour dependent, call/check before relying on it, and do not count it as trail resupply.

facilities.name: Stora Vasskärr poorhouse foundation
facilities.description: Approximate signed croft/poorhouse-remains context south of Stora Vasskärr; route-snap before treating as an authoritative archaeology pin.

facilities.name: Offergryta / giant pothole
facilities.description: Approximate notable glacial pothole/offergryta around 4-5 km from Skottvång, mentioned by official text and hiker reports; exact pin remains approximate.

facilities.name: Älgsjöbacken mine area
facilities.description: Approximate historic mine/rest area with 1600s mining remains, info board, old railway embankment, and slag heaps; exact marker should be route-snapped.

facilities.name: Spring southeast of Bredsjön
facilities.description: Official natural spring southeast of Bredsjön. Hiker reports confirm use, but filter/treat and verify flow.

facilities.name: Wet low ground before Bredsjön
facilities.description: Low ground before Bredsjön can be very wet after rain. A 2024-04-01 official-page comment mentions a flooded-creek warning, and hiker reports mention alternate-sign context and slow but passable travel; no current official fault report was found.

facilities.name: Bredsjön shelter
facilities.description: Popular lakeside official shelter and strongest Stage 16 overnight/rest node. Shelter listings indicate about four sleeping places plus benches/fireplace/toilet context; first-come, shared, non-bookable, potentially occupied in season, no guaranteed firewood, and no guaranteed trash service.

facilities.name: Bredsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at/near the Bredsjön shelter. Use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Bredsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Bredsjön shelter. Waste bins have been reported by hikers but are not guaranteed; pack out trash.

facilities.name: Bredsjön lake rest and swimming
facilities.description: Natural lake/bathing/rest context by the shelter. Lake water is not potable without treatment.

facilities.name: Bredsjön reported tent spots
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe nearby flat/rocky tentable spots, but this is not a verified bookable campsite. Follow local signs and avoid fragile ground.

facilities.name: Älskaren rest and lake-water context
facilities.description: Approximate scenic rest/fire context near lake Älskaren from official and blog descriptions; lake water requires treatment and ground is reported sloping/stony, so do not present this as a campsite.

facilities.name: Post-Älskaren picnic table
facilities.description: Approximate small-knoll picnic-table context after Älskaren from hiker reports. Useful rest stop, but explicitly not a tent spot until route-snapped and field-verified.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring near the endpoint; 2024 hikers found water but filtered it and noted heavy mosquitoes around the spring. Treat/filter and expect insects/wet ground in season.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult parking
facilities.description: Parking/access for Harsjöhult, Gallsjömossen, stage 16, stage 16:1, and stage 17. Check local road and parking signs.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen access point.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult stage junction
facilities.description: OSM node 2926356244 is the clean Stage 16-to-Stage 17 junction. Connector 16:1 arrives via the shared final way 1460426509 roughly 40-50 m before this split, matching official connector text.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Adjacent official connector text describes Harsjöhult as suitable for tenting with spring nearby; this is not a developed or guaranteed campsite with toilet/shelter, and reserve signs/fire bans still apply.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen reserve warning
facilities.description: Reserve context near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs except wood for a small fire where allowed, collect restricted plants/fungi/lichens beyond berries, edible mushrooms and flowers for personal use, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. Fire bans and local signs override the small-fire exception.

facilities.name: Stage 17 continuation caveat
facilities.description: If continuing toward Finnsjön, official Stage 17 warns that an older marked shelter east of Harsjön does not exist and that Finnsjön cannot be reached by car because of a road barrier; Lantmäteriet-based maps may lag current trail routing.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk transit via stage 16:1
facilities.description: Practical public-transport approach to Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen is usually bus 301 from Strängnäs or 306 from Läggesta to Åkers Styckebruk, then about 8 km along stage 16:1.
